adjustment_rules.execution_cost_filter: Require expected gross movement >= 4x stress round-trip cost before entry.
adjustment_rules.holding_horizon: Evaluate 6, 24, 48, and 96 completed-hour labels without overlapping samples.
adjustment_rules.entry_confirmation: Require signal persistence and enter only on the next completed candle.
adjustment_rules.regime_filter: Segment trend, range, expansion, contraction, and crisis regimes.
adjustment_rules.exit_logic: Compare time stop, signal decay, ATR stop, trailing stop, and profit-lock variants.
adjustment_rules.asset_selection: Select the strongest liquid leader only when relative strength is significant.
adjustment_rules.position_sizing: Volatility-scale within the existing hard portfolio risk caps.
